title: 20-Year Treasury Bond auction (January second reopening) — the leg the 2027-01-14 announcement sizes, and the slot whose four grading statistics turn out to be one
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), RE-FETCHED direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 for this initial research (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) and its text layer decompressed stream-by-stream — an independent second read of the same primary the proposing sweep used. Row reads verbatim `20-Year  BONDR / Thursday, January 14, 2027 / Wednesday, January 20, 2027 / Friday, January 22, 2027`, and the same fetch carries `Holiday - Monday, January 18, 2027 - Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr.` four lines below it. The trailing `R` is Treasury's reopening marker; the same fetch shows the `20-Year  BOND` new issue on 2026-11-18 without it, which is what fixes this sale as the SECOND reopening of that CUSIP. The 1:00 p.m. ET bidding deadline is NOT taken from the schedule — it is fiscaldata `auctions_query`'s `closing_time_comp`, which reads `01:00 PM` on every 20-Year auction since 2020-05 (n=77, pulled 2026-09-09, HTTP 200). Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the 2027-01-14 announcement itself. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE written 2026-09-09 by this event's own never-assessed initial research, promoting the single proposal that existed for this id (proposals/treasury-20y-bond-2027-01-20.from-treasury-coupon-announcement-2027-01-14.json, read in full first per EVENT-RESEARCH.md). THE FINDING THAT EARNED THE TITLE CHANGE: the four statistics this calendar grades a 20-Year print on are not four. Across all 24 20-Year reopenings sold at $13B (fiscaldata auctions_query, 2023-09-19 onward, pulled 2026-09-09), bid-to-cover correlates with gross competitive tendered dollars at r=0.999 (arithmetic, offering is constant), with primary-dealer take at r=-0.849 (t=-7.53) and with the high-minus-median yield dispersion at r=-0.769 (t=-5.64). Only the INDIRECT/DIRECT split is close to orthogonal — r=+0.337 (t=1.68) and r=+0.384 (t=1.95), neither significant. So the 10-21 sibling's rule 'composition beats the ratio' is right about direct share and WRONG about dealer take, which is 72% shared variance with the ratio it is supposed to check. Grade on two numbers, not four. GRADING YARDSTICK, second-reopening slot at constant $13B only (n=12): floor 2.53, p25 2.62, median 2.68, p75 2.76, ceiling 2.86; direct share 12.3/15.9/18.9/22.1/29.1 on the competitive base. THREE HYPOTHESES CHECKED AND KILLED, recorded so no later session re-runs them: (a) the 10-21 ledger's n=15 second-reopening band pools three $12B auctions with twelve $13B ones — the same size-pooling error one level down — but constraining to constant size moves floor 2.53->2.53 and median 2.68->2.68, so its thresholds survive; (b) there is no January or MLK-week effect — January 20-Year auction days average -4.0bp on the 20Y only because of 2023-01-18's -16bp, and drop that one session and it is -1.6bp against -1.19bp for every other month, with MLK-week sessions averaging 4.13bp absolute against 4.31bp for all 1,420 sessions since 2021; (c) the December-to-January year-turn lift is 3 up and 4 down across seven paired cycles. SIZE EXPECTATION $13B on a 24-of-24 reopening base rate, published in the 2026-11-04 refunding statement and read back on 2027-01-14 — owned by the announcement lane and deliberately NOT re-registered here. PREDECESSOR, AND THE REASON IT IS A POOR BASELINE: the first reopening of this CUSIP auctions 2026-12-23, later than any December 20-Year auction on record (every prior one fell between the 17th and the 21st), into Christmas week beside pce-2026-12-23 and the 12-24 half day. Proposed to the calendar in this PR. SESSION CONTEXT: MLK compresses the 6/13/26/52-week bill slate that normally splits Monday and Tuesday into one Tuesday 2027-01-19, this sale is Wednesday, the 10-Year TIPS new issue is Thursday 2027-01-21, vix-expiration-2027-01-20 settles the same morning, and the FOMC blackout has been running since 2027-01-16 into fomc-2027-01-27.
